## Introduction


Recall the `books_subset` dataframe from Problem Set 2.

Each row represents a book; each column is a variable to describe the book. We will focus on the variables `amazon_price` (list price on Amazon in US dollars), `weight_oz` (weight of the book in ounces), and `hard_paper` (a categorical variable indicating if the book is a paperback [P] or hardcover [H]). Below, we have the first ten rows of `books_subset`, with only the relevant columns included.

## Problem 1: Linear Regression

Consider this regression model:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mod <- lm(amazon_price ~ weight_oz + hard_paper, data = books_subset)
get_regression_table(mod)
```
